sections.kicker: Prepared for faces. by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: faces. has an idea of its own: a scan. The page hides it behind the startup look.
sections.keep: Your line "see what actually works." It speaks to people tired of buying products that promise everything.

pins.what: The headline names a category, not faces.
pins.why: Skin health membership could describe several new skincare startups.
pins.how: Lead with what faces. does that others do not, then name the format.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: At launch, you get filed with every other skincare subscription.

pins.area: Black sans serif headline, white space and a single portrait on the right
pins.what: The page uses the default startup layout.
pins.why: This is why it looks like everyone else: black sans headline, white space and one portrait are the look of the category.
pins.how: Find one visual idea that only faces. would use and repeat it everywhere.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Visitors remember the look of the category, not the name.

pins.area: Thin scan brackets frame the cheek in the portrait
pins.what: Faint scan brackets frame the cheek in the portrait.
pins.why: It is the one ownable idea on the page: faces. reads skin.
pins.how: Make the scan frame the brand mark, large and everywhere.
pins.label: Your hero
pins.cost: Your most distinct idea stays a detail nobody notices.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on faces.'s own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.
